findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_send_action_api, list_open_venue_tasks, list_open_research_studies · Private data: email_send_action_api, au_tax_compliance_pack, gdpr_compliance_pack, hipaa_compliance_pack, asic_accc_guidance_pack, aviation_safety_pack, dyn_acaeb8f8c93241a0 · Public sink: email_send_action_api, list_open_venue_tasks, list_open_research_studies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_send_action_api, list_open_venue_tasks, list_open_research_studies · Private data: email_send_action_api, au_tax_compliance_pack, gdpr_compliance_pack, hipaa_compliance_pack, asic_accc_guidance_pack, aviation_safety_pack, dyn_acaeb8f8c93241a0 · Public sink: email_send_action_api, list_open_venue_tasks, list_open_research_studies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
